book.name: 1 Timocheyo
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Timocheyo

content: Ne Pauli, natenga jwa Yecho Kilichitu kwa nhwilo gwa Chapanga ndi Nkomboche gwito na Yecho Kilichitu ndi lihobholelo lito.
Ninnyandikila Timocheyo mwanango jwa chakaka mu kihobholelo. Ninnyope umbone na kiya na uteeke kuhumii kwa Chapanga Tate gwito na Yecho Kilichitu Bhambo gwito.
Lupwato panane jha mabholo ghuwange
Mbala ntame kwenio ku Epecho, ngita punipembelikiya punikibha nikajhenda ku Makedoniya. Bhabhii bhando bhange kwenio bhibhola mabholo ghuwange, makanakiye bhando bheniya.
Mwalobholela bhaleka kulingukiya kwamahele mu ibheluko pamonga na malobhe gha akahoko, gheniya ghileta kutaungana tu, ghichenga jhe lihengo lya Chapanga mu kihobholelo.
Kilebhe kikolongwa cha malaghalikilo ghango ndi upalo, ghuubhoka mumwojho gwambone, na kuhaghuu na kuhenga ghambone na kihobholelo cha uchakaka.
Bhando bhange bhahobhalile na kughalambukila mu malongocho gha kimbebhebhe.
Bhipala kubhehe bhabhola bha malaghalikilo gha Mucha, nambo bhimanya ndeka chibhalongela amu malobhe ghabhe bhene amu mambu ghibhajhoha.
Tumanya Malaghalikilo ndi ghambone, anda ghatumike chiipalwa.

Helahela tumanya kubhehe Lilaghalikilo liletitwe kwa nhwalo gwa bhando bhambone jhe, nambo kwa bhando bhangakamuu lilaghalikilo, bhangajhokanikiya, bhangannyopa Chapanga na akahako, bhando bhibhakengama gha nnema na bhangamanya ndela jha Chapanga, bhando bhibhakoma akatate bhabhe na akama jhe bhabhe, amu bhibhakoma bhando.

Lilaghalikilo liletitwe kunhwalo gwa bhibhahenga ngongola, bhibhagholoka na akanalome ajhabhe, bhibhakwatuu bhando, akawange na bhilapii kuwange amu bhihenga kilebhe chochoha chikibhii kuyeto na mabholo gha uchakaka.
Mabholo gheniya ghabhii mu Lilobhe lya Mbone lya Chapanga jhuna ung'alicho ndi lilobhe limbekiwe nenga natangachila bhando.
Kiya jha Chapanga kwa Pauli
Ninchenguu Yecho Kilichitu Bhambo gwito jwambekii makakala kunhwalo amwene ne ndi nihobholeka, ngahagwila nintumikila,
pamonga na makacho ninighita na kwang'aha na kwatende chanake bhando bhinnyeketeketii Kilichitu. Nambo Chapanga ngamonila kiya, kwa nhwalo nakibha nalindindilima kabhele nanga kihobholelo.
Nambo Bhambo gwito ngandweleya twe umbone, ngambekiya kihobholelo na upalo mu kulombana na Kilichitu Yecho.
Lilobhe lende ndi lya chakaka, kabhele ipalwa kujheketelwa na kuhobholeka: Kilichitu Yecho pahikita pannema pano kwakombola bhando bhubhabhii na uhakaho. Na nenga nnemwite hake kupeta bhando bhoha,

nambo Chapanga ngamonila kiya ndi kupala Kilichitu Yecho alangiye luhimbililo lwoha kwa nenga mii nauhakaho kupeta bhoha, ngita nnandanikiho kwa bhala bhoha bhibhapala kunnyeketela na kupokela ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Kwa Munahota Nkolongwa jwangawegha machiko ghoha ghangapeta, jwangahwe, jwanga bhonekana, ndi Chapanga kanjika ndo, kwa jwenio kubhii na ichima na ung'alicho gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta! Amina.
Timocheyo ndi mwanango mu kihobholelo, ninkamuwa nhwilo ghongo, kwa malobhe gha ulondole ghighalongilwa panane jhino makacho mughakengame ndi uhoto kuikengelela ngondo jha Malobhe gha Mbone,
na mukikamulile kihobholelo chino na kupala mme na mwojho gwa kuhaghula ghakuhenga ghighabhii ghambone. Bhando bhange bhakanite gheniya, yenio bhakihangabhine kihobholelo chabhe.
Pakate jhabhe ndi Humeneyo na Alekichanda, bheniya ninkamwii Limbembela, abhabhole kupala bhakoto kunnigha Chapanga.
